statement: A goal card that has been written is not a card that has been dispatched. An operator asked a session to review 'the 0.6.7 prep PR'; no such PR existed because the card was still unseated (its operator seat comment intact) and no goal-stream log named it. When an instruction presupposes an artifact a card should have produced, check the card's dispatch state, its stream log and the PR list before reporting, and name which step did not happen; do not silently do the card's work as if it had run, because that also removes the separation between the preparing session and the reviewing one.
